name: SnipSnaps
subtitle: Clean up your photo library
_categoryNote: Matches the shared App Store identity (Photo & Video primary), and the Mac binary uses public.app-category.photography for Finder and Launchpad.
description:
SnipSnaps turns photo and file cleanup into quick, focused review sessions.

PHOTOS
Review recent photos, screenshots, videos, screen recordings, large photos, Live Photos, bursts, old favorites, On This Day memories, random shots, or similar-looking groups. Keep what matters, mark what does not, and confirm once at the end.

FILES
Choose Downloads, Desktop, Documents, or any folder you grant. Browse everything or focus on large, old, screenshot, or duplicate files. Exclude folders you want to protect. Swipe or use keyboard shortcuts to keep items or move them to the Trash; you can also move an enclosing folder to the Trash after confirmation. Trash actions stay recoverable.

Use SnipSnaps to:

- Clear photo clutter and compare similar-looking shots
- Review Mac folders by size, age, or type
- Exclude projects and other folders that should never be scanned
- Move unwanted files or folders to the Trash
- Set an optional daily cleanup reminder
- Track how many items and how much storage you have cleared

SnipSnaps requires no account and includes no ads or analytics. Everything happens on your Mac. Photo access is used only for the library you grant, and file access is limited to folders you explicitly choose.
promotionalText: Clear photo and file clutter in quick, focused sessions. Review by size, age, or type, then move unwanted items to the Trash.
_keywordsNote: 100-character max, comma-separated, no spaces after commas. Current length is 97 characters.
whatsNew:
• Enjoy a refreshed Liquid Glass interface on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, with clearer review controls, a floating tab bar on iPhone, and livelier tap feedback.
• Tune Similar matching with a new slider in Settings. Choose Strict for near-identical shots, Balanced for the familiar matching behavior, or Loose to find more lookalikes.
• Pull to refresh photo counts on iPhone and iPad. Photos access is now requested only when you choose Enable.
• On Mac, file review categories sit above your folders so they stay easy to reach.
• Review large Mac file collections faster with much lower memory use.
• Improve contrast, spacing, larger-text layouts, and VoiceOver descriptions across Home, review controls, and Settings.
• Make photo counts refresh more reliably, including Large Photos, and cancel file previews when they are no longer needed.

reviewNotes:
SnipSnaps requires no account, sign-in, or network access. All processing happens locally on the Mac.

PHOTOS
Click Enable and grant Photos access when prompted, choose a category, and review with swipes or the visible Keep and Delete controls. Confirmed photo deletions use the system Photos API and move items to Recently Deleted.

FILES
1. Open Files and click + to grant Downloads, Desktop, Documents, or a temporary test folder.
2. Choose Everything, Large, Old, Screenshots, or Duplicates.
3. Use the visible Folder menu during review to exclude an enclosing subfolder or move it to the Trash. Both actions require an eligible subfolder inside a granted review folder; a top-level granted folder is protected from this shortcut.
4. Individual files marked for removal move to the Trash only after confirmation and remain recoverable.

Keyboard shortcuts: Left arrow = keep, Right arrow or Delete = move to Trash, Space = Quick Look, Cmd-Z = undo, Esc = exit review.

App Sandbox is enabled. Entitlements are limited to user-selected file access, app-scoped bookmarks, and Photos-library access. The app contains no third-party SDKs, analytics, advertising, or networking.

Version 1.3.0 refreshes the interface and adds a Similarity slider in Settings. Changes to the slider apply to the next Similar scan.

privacy.photoLibraryPurpose: Accesses the user's photo library on device to display review sessions and delete only the photos the user explicitly selects.
privacy.fileAccessPurpose: Accesses only folders the user explicitly grants via the system open panel, persisted as app-scoped security-scoped bookmarks, to review and move selected files to the Trash. No file contents leave the device.

pricing._note: The universal app is free and available in every current App Store territory. Apple's public API does not allow changing the existing availableInNewTerritories flag.

discoverability._note: Apple has not generated app tags for this app; developers cannot create them directly.
